items.concept: Speculative call option — initial recognition at premium; period-end fair-value adjusting JEs (emphasis) through net income; subsequent measurement schedule; disposal/sale settlement
Number-variant twin — speculative call option initial recognition, period-end FV adjusting JEs (emphasis), subsequent measurement schedule through NI, and disposal settlement

Fair value hedges — put option on HTM bonds (initial recognition; dual period-end FV AJs through NI; settlement); interest rate swap on fixed-rate note (zero-value inception; cash settlement; period-end AJs on swap and note payable)
Cash flow hedge futures — zero-cost inception; period-end FV AJ through OCI; subsequent measurement; settlement on purchase; reclassification from AOCI into COGS when inventory sold
Classification — FV changes in NI vs OCI by designation; period-end dual AJs for fair value hedge of fixed-rate liability (swap + note payable)
